label: a_t10_i01_npc_03_01
text: The community center is a place where residents\ncan come together to socialize, learn, and relax!

label: a_t10_i01_npc_03_02
text: Have you been to the festival yet? It’ll be running\nfor a while, so go have some fun!

label: a_t10_i01_npc_03_03
text: I heard a huge noise coming from Loyalty Plaza...\nWe didn’t have any fireworks planned, did we?

label: a_t10_i01_npc_03_04
text: I had no idea Ogerpon’s face was so adorable...\nI should talk to the caretaker about whipping up\r\nsome Ogerpon souvenirs...

label: a_t10_i01_npc_04_01
text: The Paldea region has that one really big school,\nright?

label: a_t10_i01_npc_04_02
text:
Nothing says “festival” like a great big bowl of
shaved ice!\c
My favorite flavor is Alola Blue. It’ll turn your
tongue blue, though!

label: a_t10_i01_npc_04_03
text: What’s all that commotion outside? Ooh, let me\nguess—the Loyal Three have come back to life!\c\nHaha, nah. I’m just pulling your leg!

label: a_t10_i01_npc_04_04
text: You actually got to meet Ogerpon?!\c\nI bet ogre masks are going to be real popular at\nnext year’s festival!
